context:
Goal: one uniform direction for every watch, wake, sweep, reap and log, in place of the patchwork of lessons, bugs and fixes (your note on item 180, 06:50 CST).
Problem (rule): the rule says a log needs a named reader or it is not written. Four have none: the agent-end payload log, janitor-runs.jsonl, launchd-sweep.log and its .err.log. A fifth, the "STOP seen" line in shadow.log, is the only evidence that the decision mod fires, but nothing reads it live.
Based on (read): `git grep` finds no reader for the four.
Departs from: main — deletes four log writers; keeps "STOP seen" until another fire-check lands.

options.gain: Less writing and less to read.
options.how: Remove the four log writers; keep "STOP seen" until a fire-check replaces it.
options.label: Delete the four now; keep "STOP seen" for now
options.lose: If a reader was missed, its data stops.

options.how: Each of the four logs gets a named reader in its record.
options.label: Name a reader for each

ref: item 180; Sonnet workflow align-watchers (3 mappers, a synthesis and a critic), 06:58 CST
reply: Done: claude-settings #1239 merged (d466c5c12). Closed 14:44 CST Nov 6.
title: Should logs with no named reader be deleted now?
why: Recommended: a. No reader exists for the four, so they cost writes and give nothing.
